scheduling.run_limitations: GitHub schedules may be delayed or skipped, so no guaranteed coverage by a fixed deadline

owner_context_policy: Subordinate worker instructions contain publicly approved payment routes and work mission only; no personal details
external_identity_claims: These are software research roles, not recruited humans or independent authenticated social accounts
reporting_policy: Each worker independently researches with a unique agent identity and reports to exactly one manager. Each manager independently reviews 50 worker roles and reports to exactly one director. Each of the 2 independent assistants reports only to its director. Each director reports only to the owner. Shared findings are copied as source-linked handoffs, never dual reporting lines.
implementation_truth: These are distinct configured autonomous inference roles, not 7680 separate authenticated social accounts, distinct processes or simultaneous cloud instances. Only activated rotational worker slots actually run.
